title: Run the offline checks of the kit
command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q && \
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/publish_check.py && \
  python3 scripts/tenant_pi.py check-runtime
setup: rm "$HOME/<the URL of the tenant-pi repository>"

replace.what: the run time of the tests
